in_sanskrit.name: Chikun
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Mouse
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chikun एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chakra', meaning circle. In Hindu mythology, the mouse is a symbol of Ganesha, the elephant-headed god who is the remover of obstacles. The name 'Chikun' could be derived from 'Chikura' or 'Chikku', which means 'mouse' in various Indian languages.
